hook_text: The best leaders have two ears and one mouth, and they use them in that order.
clip_script: Gqeberha. Mama Nomsa runs a soup kitchen from her garage. Every day she asks people what they need and listens. That is a leader who serves. Archbishop Desmond Tutu sat for hours and listened to the stories of people who had been hurt during apartheid. Albertina Sisulu worked as a nurse for decades and gave her life to her community. A good leader listens, serves the people, and works for the good of others, not for themselves.
visual_style: Whiteboard big ear and a soup pot, then three leaders appearing, each with a speech bubble that turns into a heart.
mood: Warm and gentle, with deep respect.
pacing: One quality at a time, each with one leader, then the big idea.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and practise listening to someone without interrupting.
